meta.name: ai-shifu-course-creator
meta.description: Use when the user works with AI-Shifu (AI师傅) courses in any capacity of creating, writing, editing, rewriting, optimizing, reordering, deploying, publishing, previewing, or managing Teaching Prompts (per-lesson) and Course Prompts (course-level) — both written in MarkdownFlow (MDF). Covers the full course lifecycle — from converting raw material into structured lessons, to scripting interactions (single-select, multi-select, input, branching), adding variables, images, and course prompts, to deploying and managing live courses on the AI-Shifu platform. Also covers post-deployment analytics on those courses — learner count, completion rate, stuck lessons, orders, revenue, ratings, credit consumption, audience profiles, and individual learner tracking. Trigger on any mention of AI-Shifu, AI师傅, MarkdownFlow, Teaching Prompt, Course Prompt authoring, course analytics, creator analytics, 学习人数, 完成率, 卡课节, 订单收入, 积分消耗, or learner progress.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建和管理AI-Shifu平台上的课程内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为AI-Shifu平台编写、部署或分析课程。
copy.tagline_en: Create and manage course content on the AI-Shifu platform
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write, deploy, or analyze courses on the AI-Shifu platform.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你创建、编辑、优化和部署 AI 师傅（AI-Shifu）互动课程。它可以把原始材料转换成结构化的课程教案，并管理课程上线后的数据，比如学习人数和完成率。
howto.when: 当你提到“AI师傅”、“MarkdownFlow”、“课程教案”等关键词，或者要求创建、编辑、部署 AI 师傅课程时触发。

say.text: 帮我用这份讲义创建一门 AI 师傅课程。
say.note: Claude 会启动端到端流程，生成课程并部署。

say.text: 查看课程“Python入门”的学习人数和完成率。
say.note: Claude 会查询该课程的课后分析数据。

say.text: 给课程“数学基础”添加一个选择题互动。
say.note: Claude 会在指定课程中插入一个选择题。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you create, edit, optimize, and deploy AI-Shifu interactive courses. It converts raw material into structured lesson prompts and manages post-deployment analytics like learner count and completion rate.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "AI-Shifu", "AI师傅", "MarkdownFlow", "Teaching Prompt", or ask to create, edit, or deploy an AI-Shifu course.

say_en.text: Create an AI-Shifu course from this lecture material.
say_en.note: Claude will run the end-to-end pipeline to generate and deploy the course.

say_en.text: Show learner count and completion rate for the course "Python Basics".
say_en.note: Claude will query the analytics data for that course.

say_en.text: Add a single-select interaction to the course "Math Fundamentals".
say_en.note: Claude will insert a single-select question into the specified course.
